'''Bampa'k IV''' was a terrestrial astronomical object with a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] land.<ref name="Collector's CD Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bampa'k IV was introduced in [[Prima Games]]' [[1995]] [[TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire: Official Secrets & Solutions|strategy guide]] for [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire|''Defender of the Empire'']], an expansion pack for [[Totally Games]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], both released in [[1994]]. The astronomical object was mentioned in the section for the fourth [[Missile Boat]] combat training mission, "Missile Boat vs. TIE Defender." The guide states there that if the player believed that most of the parked [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] in the mission were easy targets, they would like the lovely swamp land on Bampa'k IV.<ref name="Defender Guide">''[[TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire: Official Secrets & Solutions]]''</ref> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Bampa'k IV was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
